notes.anti_compounding_intent: 取最狠的一个、不连乘 — risk discounts are NOT multiplied together; only the single harshest applies, so a stock isn't double/triple-shrunk
notes.min_floor_intent: below minimum executable size → observe (never place a sub-minimum order)
notes.cap_values_are_forward: 单票 10% / 总仓 60% / 同主题 30% / 单笔风险 0.75% etc. = §13.1 #4 prior, not pinned
notes.scope: 削减叠法 pipeline only; macro_cluster (#31) / symbol_cooldown (#23) / cash_allocation (#25) / ship-gate sizing = separate §8 slices
